purpose: イラストの方向性を比較する試作。本番未反映。

variants.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create a polished illustration concept comparison sheet for TOKKATSU広場, a Japanese elementary-school educational website. Landscape canvas with THREE equally sized side-by-side scene panels. Each panel is a generously sized scene with large expressive children, NOT tiny distant figures. Titles above each panel, exact Japanese text: left 「運動会」 middle 「児童会」 right 「学級会」. No other words or lettering. Each scene must communicate its activity even without its title. Faces extremely clear: distinct eyes, eyebrows, noses and expressive mouths, different hairstyles, faces in front or three-quarter view. Cute warm Japanese elementary school children, natural hands and joints, friendly for children and teachers. Professional composed editorial illustration, excellent draftsmanship, controlled visual hierarchy, background quieter than people. Heads at least 1/5 of character height, few well drawn characters instead of crowds, expressive eye contact and interaction.
Left: Japanese school sports day, red and white caps and PE clothes, a dynamic close-up relay baton handoff by two running children with bent elbows and knees and leaning torsos, one cheering child further back, white running track and festive triangular bunting establish sports day. Both runners' faces fully visible. No clutter.
Middle: student council-led school assembly, two older elementary students leading the assembly with a microphone and illustrated agenda clipboard at a low small podium, welcoming hand gestures; two younger pupils participate and respond, all their faces visible in three-quarter view. Different ages, student leadership, voluntary participation and shared excitement evident. School hall hinted subtly. No adult lecturer, no generic classroom, no political rally.
Right: class meeting, 4 pupils in a compact open semicircle of desks; pupil moderator at the chalkboard holding a discussion card, one pupil raising a hand and another listening attentively, a pupil secretary with notebook. Faces visible in frontal or three-quarter view, avoid backs-of-head dominating the image. Chalkboard has structured colored proposal cards with no text. The class is discussing and deciding together, not listening to a teacher. No adult.
Palette connects to current site: cream, warm red-orange, school blue, leaf green, sunflower yellow, natural warm skin tones; allow carefully restrained highlights/shadows. NO logos, watermarks, tiny repetitive people, stick limbs, extra fingers, illegible small text. Keep all figures fully inside each panel.
STYLE A: refined flat editorial illustration with beautifully controlled dark warm outlines, crisp organic curves, clean flat colors plus one restrained shadow tone. Charming original character design, expressive readable faces, slight three-quarter depth in props. Contemporary premium educational-book illustration. Cream background, strong clear silhouettes, no paper texture. Each panel has a discrete thin pastel frame. Design a truly finished art piece, not an SVG diagram.
